blocks.text: SIARGAO – Filipino wildcards John Mark Tokong and Jayuard Alciso are through to Round 2 of the World Surf League (WSL) Championship Tour Philippines Pro after beating highly fancied rivals at Cloud 9 here Sunday. Tokong, fondly called Marama in the local circuit, beat Brazilian world No. 11 Samuel Pupo, 16.60-11.00, in their opening-round heat. […]...
